summary: Telefonica Brasil filed a 6-K reporting its 267th Fiscal Council meeting, which approved a proposed Interest on Capital (IoC) distribution. The gross amount is R$500 million (net R$412.5 million), equal to R$0.15646482856 per share gross, based on the August 31, 2026 shareholding position. The record date is September 25, 2026; shares become ex-IoC thereafter. Payment is due by April 30, 2027, and the net amount will count toward the mandatory minimum dividend for fiscal 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the 2027 ordinary meeting. The buyback program could alter per-share figures. Watch for record-date updates and the board's formal declaration.
